title: Clean Energy
question_text: How much should government do to expand clean energy?

stances.text: Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.
Fund clean energy with major subsidies, tax credits, and public investment.
Speed up clean energy by cutting permitting red tape and upgrading the grid.
Stay neutral on energy and let the market choose among all sources.
End government subsidies and mandates for clean energy.
